Our story

A city singing with one voice

Peterborough Alive began in 2018 as a gift to the city from RCCG City of Grace Church — a free music event to honour God and bring people together. Since then it has grown into an annual celebration of praise and worship, welcoming artists and neighbours from across Peterborough and beyond.

Past stages have hosted Nathaniel Bassey, Philippa Hanna, Faith Child, Lima Blaze and the Peterborough Alive Mass Choir — with room at the front for anyone who simply wants to join in.
